scenario: WF-10 ([LNUL.5.3]/[LNUL.8.9]) — `(s.state ?? 100.0) > 85` FIRES on null: the default 100.0 crosses the threshold. fact_count 2.
rules_ds:
schema Sensor scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    state: Float? mutable

schema Marker scope logical:
    entity_id: String key

rule r:
    Sensor s where (s.state ?? 100.0) > 85.0
->
    emit Marker logical entity_id: s.entity_id
